name: Ultimate Factory
source:
This is a simulation game in which you manage a fictional post-war factory in the 21st century.
Build strong and intimate relationships with co-workers and clients alike, all while working to stay out of the red.
translation:
这是一款模拟游戏，你在21世纪管理一家虚构的战后工厂。
与同事和客户建立牢固而亲密的关系，同时努力避免亏损。
